# Creature

- [[Creature/Charybdis]] — Charybdis — A deadly whirlpool that swallows ships whole.
- [[Creature/Polyphemus]] — Polyphemus — A man-eating cyclops, son of Poseidon, blinded by Odysseus.
- [[Creature/Scylla]] — Scylla — A six-headed sea monster who preys on passing sailors.
- [[Creature/TheSirens]] — TheSirens — Enchanting creatures whose song lures sailors to their doom.
